name: Haruna Tsukimura
want: give her children choices she never had
secret: Her husband's hotel job in Tokyo is not going well and he wants to come home, which the inn can't afford.
voice: Gentle, dry asides, signs off every call with "eat properly".
description: Runs the inn's kitchen: local shamo chicken, river fish, apples from the eastern hills. Her husband works at a hotel in Tokyo and comes home for holidays.
appearance: Hair tied in a headscarf, kitchen-scarred hands, a tired kind smile.
